title: CAPE (caffeine and physical performance in mental illness)
summary: The aim of the pilot study is to investigate the effects of anamnestic coffee consumption on physical performance in patients with a depressive episode.

interventions.name: For this study, inpatients and day-cinical patients with a depressive illness who are already stable on their medication (at least a week) are being recruited. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Sufficient knowledge of German
Ability to consent
Voluntary treatment
Diagnosis of a depressive episode
No diagnosed, current addiction disorder (nicotine, alcohol, illegal drugs)
No contraindication to exercise
Stable long-term medication (one week)
BMI < 30 kg/m²
No known high consumption of other caffeinated drinks or foods (> 1 cup of black or green tea/day, daily consumption of energy drinks or dietary supplements containing caffeine
Exclusion criteria:
Age < 18 years or > 65 years
Lack of knowledge of German
Lack of ability to consent
Involuntary treatment
Diagnosed current addiction disorder (nicotine, alcohol, illegal drugs)
Contraindications to physical exercise
Pregnancy and breast feeding period
Taking steroids during the study period
Known high consumption of other caffeinated drinks or
Food (> 1 cup of black or green tea/day, daily consumption of energy drinks or dietary supplements with caffeine)
Relevant orthopedic or internal diseases that prevent cardiopulmonary exercise
